name: AdLoop
description: Read and change Google Ads, Reddit Ads, GA4 and Tag Manager from Claude or ChatGPT, with every change shown as a preview before it applies, for marketers and PPC managers.

skills.name: Campaign Performance
skills.description: Reports Google Ads campaign and ad performance, including impressions, clicks, cost, conversions, CPA and impression share.

skills.name: Run GA4 Report
skills.description: Runs custom and real-time GA4 reports on sessions, users, key events and pages, with filters and a comparison period.

skills.name: Check Attribution
skills.description: Compares Ads-reported conversions with GA4 events and diagnoses gaps from consent, attribution windows or broken tracking.

skills.name: Draft Campaign
skills.description: Drafts Google Ads campaigns, ad groups and responsive search ads as paused previews that apply only after you approve.

skills.name: Reddit Ads Performance
skills.description: Reports Reddit Ads spend, clicks, CTR, CPC, conversions, CPA and ROAS by account, campaign, ad group or ad.
